# Reference-runner membership code review, fix round one

**Verdict: FAIL — source-only affected rereview.**

C1 is resolved: split traversal collects owned descriptors and local issues before mutating the module. C2 is resolved: explicit null or invalid split list fields are rejected before child/aggregate relationships are published. All 18 previous test bodies remain byte-identical, and the added nineteenth test exercises ten invalid shapes. Every other previously reviewed file is unchanged, including all 16 original fixtures. No compiler, test, SDK, app or shared-cache execution occurred.

**C3 / P2 — accepted filter shapes still include producer-rejected configurations** (`android_reference_membership.rs:1010`). Any string or null `test_filter` passes the shape check. A string such as `"("` is rejected by the pinned `_validate_split_test_filter`. Two split entries with missing, null or empty filters are rejected by `_gen_split_test_excludes` because multiple catch-all splits are forbidden. Current derivation nevertheless emits automatic child membership and an aggregate relationship, without a specific unresolved producer constraint.

Retain the literal inputs, flag known rejected filter configurations explicitly, and suppress trusted split/aggregate membership for those cases. Any semantics beyond the bounded supported grammar should remain unresolved. Add regressions for an invalid literal filter and multiple falsey/missing filters while preserving all existing positive assertions and fixtures.

The accompanying JSON binds reviewed file hashes and the original failure report. Runtime validation remains pending. This reviewer read hold is released after report creation.
